task: multi-query associative recall with a 64-token gap
purpose: compare QKV adaptation components under matched learning conditions
precision: bf16 autocast, FP32 parameters and optimizer updates

development.selection: lowest final validation cross-entropy among completed finite runs within each optimizer family

confirmation.learning_rates: selected AdamW rate; all Tiger modes share selected tiger-full rate
confirmation.primary_metric: test cross-entropy after the fixed 1000-update budget
confirmation.test_access: one final evaluation per run, no setting changes after confirmation begins

schedule: 5 percent linear warmup then cosine toward 0.1 of base LR, shared across modes
controls: same initial weights, generated examples, clipping and schedule per paired seed; Tiger tag scales and trust remain part of the optimizer recipe
scope: controlled synthetic retrieval, not natural-language quality or a general optimizer ranking
timing: diagnostic only; other CPU jobs may remain active on the host
